text: Purina Ecosystem v2.0 – Component page playbook
Before starting using this guide, go through Purina V2.0 - Introduction playbook.doc for further information.
Create / edit component pages
The instructions below will demonstrate how to create a component page or edit an existing one.
Steps:

rows.text:
Login on the site backend
Click on Contenido  Añadir contenido  Component page
or use URL /node/add/dsu_component_page

text: On “Crear component page”, enter the following data:
Título			page title
Brand
How to add / remove a block / component on the component page:

rows.text: To add a block look for the “Components” area as showed here:

Select the component type to be added to the page using the drop-down
Click on “Add another component”
Component fields to be fulfilled will be displayed.
To remove one block, look for the block to be deleted, click on the 3 small points on the right and click on “Eliminar”

text: Component BANNER – single banner
There are 5 different banner types which will need different sets of information to be fulfilled. See below examples of each banner type.

Component Banner wrapper – carrousel with “n” banners
Select component type = “Banner wrapper” and click on “Add another component”
Banner slider configuration;

After configuring the slider settings, the component banner (described above) is available to be fulfilled the same way how described above.

rows.text: To add the next banner, click on the button “Añadir banner” and follow the same steps.

Menus
There are different types of menus:
Navegación principal 		menu to be displayed on all pages with the main CTAs
Footer				menu to be displayed on the bottom of the page
Copyright			menu to be displayed below the footer with T&C, privacidad, cookies CTAs
Menu per brand 		each brand will have its won sub-menu
To create or edit one of the menus listed above, go to Administrar  Estructura  Menus and look for the menu to be updated. URL /admin/structure/menu/manage/
Click on “Añadir enlace” to add a new CTA or click on “Editar” to change the existing one.
Enter the following data:
Titulo del enlace del menú	text to be displayed on the menu
Enlace				If this entry is just a ‘title” without link, enter the text <nolink> as shown above.

Enlace				If this entry is to call a specific URL, enter the URL here. It can be a URL from the site or an external one. In case of being an URL from the site, always enter the URL without the domain, as shown above.
Enlace Padre			if this CTA has an actual URL, this field must be filled with the group (enlace padre) that this new entry will be part of.
To move the position of a CTA on the menu, click on the entry to be moved and drag it up or down to the desired position.
To unpublish a CTA (remove from the main menu or from footer), unflag the field “Activado”.
Main menu – Navegación principal
1st level
2nd level – after clicking on one of the main CTA´s
Access the URL /admin/structure/menu/manage/ and look for the menu Navegación principal.
Do not use the icon the menu 1st level. Only on the 2nd level.
Banner Card
The 2nd level of this menu allows you to add 2 CTAs with images like the example above. Important: it is mandatory to have at least one “simple” CTA without images when using this feature.
To add this kind of CTA with image + title + description, click on “Añadir nuevo” on the “Banner” area, so on the drop-down select “Banner menu”. Enter the following data:
Title			Title to be displayed on the card
HTML tag		Always H3
Description		Text to be displayed on the card just below the title
Image			upload image*
Link URL		URL to be called when clicking
Texto del enlace	not used
After entering all these data DO NOT forget to click on “Actualizar párrafo”.
Menu – per brand
Each brand must have a specific sub-menu.
Click on “+Añadir menu” and on the field “titulo” inform the name of the brand.
Click on “+Añadir enlace” and on “Título del enlace del menú.” Inform the CTA text to be displayed on the menu. On the field “Enlace”, inform the URL. Save the data.
Menu Footer
Content to be displayed on the footer of the site. Each CTA must be manually added to the footer. There isn´t any automatic update here. Maximum number of columns = 6.
Access the URL /admin/structure/menu/manage/ and look for the menu Footer.

Content: Card Grid

Used to add different types of cards. It is possible to add a general title and subtitles for the block and individual ones for each card. IMPORTANT: colors (background, texts, icons, etc) will be the same for each block, it is not possible to set different colors for each individual card.
Avanzado fields must be set up only for the whole block, not for each card. See more information on the document Purina V2.0 - Introduction playbook.docx
